what_happened: On a straight multi-lane highway, the ego braked hard for no clear reason (17 to 9.6 m/s with no lead within about 50 m), falling about 10 m behind the recorded car. Its path also wandered left, and its front-left corner hit actor 1, which was in the lane to its left just ahead. The rear contact on the ego came after this.

After handoff, the policy braked hard on an open highway with no lead vehicle within about 50 m, slowing from 16.9 to 5.6 m/s and falling about 20 m behind the recorded car. Replayed traffic coming from behind, which does not react to the ego, then ran into it. It hit the rear first, and at 7.6 s actor 28 overlapped the ego's front-right corner while the ego was edging slightly right.

On an open highway with no lead vehicle nearby (the gap ahead was over 50 m or empty), the ego braked hard for no visible reason, from 16.9 to 5.6 m/s, and ended up about 21 m behind where the recorded car was. Replayed traffic that doesn't react to the ego, which had been behind it, caught up: the ego was rear-ended, and then actor 28 coming up on its right overlapped its front corner, which was flagged as a front collision even though the ego stayed in its lane.

With a clear lane ahead (the nearest lead was over 50 m away), the ego braked hard on the highway, from 16.9 to 5.8 m/s, and drifted slightly left of the recorded path, falling about 20 m behind where the human driver was. Replayed traffic from behind first hit the ego's rear, then actor 28 caught up along the ego's right side and overlapped its front-right corner, which counted as a front collision even though the ego never drove into anything.

On an open multi-lane highway with no lead vehicle within about 50 m, the policy braked hard for no visible reason, slowing from 16.9 to 5.4 m/s while the recorded human trajectory kept going (the ego fell about 21 m behind the logged position). Following traffic caught up: the ego was rear-ended, and vehicle 28 coming from behind on the right ended up overlapping the ego's front corner, which counted as an at-fault front collision.

On an open multi-lane highway with the STRAIGHT command and nothing close ahead, the policy braked hard from 16.9 to 5.3 m/s and fell about 21 m behind where the recorded car was. Replayed traffic from behind kept its recorded speed and caught up: actor 28 came up along the ego's right side and overlapped its front corner at 7.6 s, and the ego was also hit from behind (rear_ended). The ego stayed in its lane, 0.9 m from the recorded path.

The ego was going straight on an open multi-lane highway and braked hard for no visible reason, from 16.9 to 5.2 m/s, falling about 21 m behind where the recorded human car was. Actor 18, a replayed vehicle that was following the ego, caught up and overlapped the ego's front-right, which counted as a front collision. The run also logged rear contact.

On an open multi-lane highway with no lead vehicle in its lane, the policy braked hard right after handoff, slowing from 16.9 to 5.6 m/s and falling about 20 m behind the recorded position. Replayed traffic from behind ran into it (an earlier rear contact, then vehicle 28 overlapping the ego's right front at 7.6 s), so the at-fault front/side flag comes from following traffic overrunning a car that braked for nothing.
